text: Make a silent 15-second 9:16 sneaker ad. I don’t have a photo—generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole, and no logo. Use three moving product shots, with these captions in order: “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.”, “Shop now”. Keep every caption’s full text bounds at least 15% in from each side and 20% from the top and bottom so reel buttons won’t cover them. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?
